name: codebase-skills
description: Marketplace hosting three independent plugins: codebase (onboarding, deep-dives, pattern extraction, docs-drift audits, in-repo pattern finding), productivity (general workflow skills), and engineering (domain modeling and ADRs).

plugins.name: codebase
plugins.description: Skills and agents for understanding unfamiliar codebases: whole-repo onboarding, exhaustive single-mechanism traces, transferable-pattern extraction, docs-vs-code staleness audits, and finding existing in-repo precedent before writing new code.

plugins.name: productivity
plugins.description: General workflow skills, not code-specific: design-tree interviews, conversation handoffs, visual explanations, async questionnaires, a multi-session teaching workspace, and re-pitching a message that didn't land.

plugins.name: engineering
plugins.description: Domain modeling: build and sharpen a project's ubiquitous language (CONTEXT.md) and record architecture decisions (ADRs).
